params.caption: 🎮 Phonopolis sweeps the DevGAMM Awards 2026 The third DevGAMM Awards were held on November 18 in Lisbon, Portugal, with 70 nominated games from 25 countries competing across 17 categories. Phonopolis was the night's big winner, taking both the Grand Prize and the Excellence in Visual Art award. 🕒 Nov 18, 2026 · 23:00 (GMT+3) 📰 Source: IGN 🏆 React if you love indie wins · 💬 Have you got Phonopolis on your list? #Phonopolis #DevGAMM #IndieGames #GamingNews 🔔 @LevelUpGames0
